Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 159,223 and 165,874 bytes measured off the DECODED bodies. Pre-merge diff moved 0 of 80 stored cells. Each page's own "Last Updated" line was re-read live — raid 10th August 2026 -> 2026-08-10, M+ 13th August 2026 -> 2026-08-13 — and both match the committed registry AND this run's pre-agent published-evidence artifact (resolved 2026-08-10 / 2026-08-13, 0 mismatches); no `published` value was carried forward by hand. Destruction was retried a further 4 times on its own (7 attempts total, same 76-byte body every time) before being recorded absent; its stored MID2 profile is RETAINED untouched at its own 2026-09-16 timestamp rather than deleted or re-dated, so the published pool is 23 profiles at 2026-09-23 and 1 at 2026-09-16. All 24 rows moved and the moves are the September 22 class tuning, not jitter: Shadow Priest +6.92%, Havoc DH +6.77%, Retribution Paladin +4.89%, Frost DK +4.44%, Windwalker +3.05% — every one a spec that received a buff in that pass, and the largest move is nowhere near `maxValueMovePct` 0.6, so no ack is involved. `asOf` is the report's OWN hotfix date 2026-09-22, one day old. `MID1_Raid` was not read and is not a fallback.

Three channels swept and the official revision ledger reconciled in full. (1) OFFICIAL REVISION LEDGER: `official-notes/evidence.json` (checkedAt 2026-09-23T15:11:48Z) reports both configured sources `success`. live-hotfixes topic 2336376 advanced post 1 from version 42 to **version 44** (updated 2026-09-22T23:24:01Z) — its body sha256 ca0844b2… was reproduced byte-for-byte from an independent fetch of the topic JSON this run — and the pending ledger raised **50 obligations: 23 new sections dated 2026-09-22 plus 27 removed-section tombstones**. ALL 50 are dispositioned with a specific reason and ZERO remain unresolved. The 11 Classes sections are `irrelevant` (already-covered): every line was diffed against the stored 2026-09-18 announcement entry and matches at the same values including the v3 amendments (Blood DK Death Strike +15%, Vengeance Reaver's Glaive +25%, both Warrior Mountain Thane PvP qualifiers), so reapplying them would count the same tuning twice in the feed and the outlook tally — the 2026-08-15/2026-08-18 precedent already in this ledger. The 12 Player versus Player sections are `irrelevant` as PvP-only, out of scope for this PvE tracker (rule 3c); each reason names why, including Retribution's unqualified "Hammer of Light damage increased by 20%", which is the PvP figure under the PvP heading and not the separate PvE +50%. The 27 tombstones are Blizzard trimming the 2026-08-13..08-18 blocks between v42 and v44 (confirmed against the live post, which no longer contains them); each was already excluded and never applied, so no retained tracker fact depends on it, and every tombstone is preserved. ptr-preview topic 2344395 gained **post 5** (2026-09-22T21:31Z, 411 bytes) with ZERO class sections — it is an Achievements-only note (Snake Eyes / Snake Eater / Good Night, Sweet Prince no longer required for Glory of the Wartorn Hero) — so it needs no preview note. `node src/check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD` passes. The 12.1.5 lane stayed notes-only: PHASES untouched, nothing written into ptr-builds or any `ptr` verdict, no forecast reopened, no archived 12.1 PTR metric relabelled. (2) WOWHEAD NEWS RSS: 40 items parsed per `<item>` block, newest 2026-09-23T15:00Z. No set bonus is touched anywhere in the post, so no `spec.tierSet` date advances.
